original_test_intent: Verify each SMBIOS Type 9 Current Usage enum reports the expected Available or In Use state for the approved hardware population, is attributed to the correct slot, and remains correct after reboot without altering the population.
original_method: Capture complete Type 9 records and the contemporaneous approved slot-population inventory, retain raw usage enum with designation, slot ID and bus address, compare enum to policy and optional read-only PCI enumeration, then repeat after reboot with unchanged hardware.
manual_activity: A user confirms the installed hardware population is fixed for the run, approves how firmware usage should track it and approves reboot. No card insertion/removal is part of this review case.
required_inputs: Expected Current Usage per slot under the captured hardware population
Board/riser topology and stable designation/slot-ID map
Policy for Available, In Use, Other and Unknown values
Rules for disabled, hidden, non-enumerating or firmware-reserved slots/devices
Optional read-only PCI correlation policy plus approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and optional read-only PCI inventory; do not insert/remove cards, bind/unbind drivers or change link settings.
Freeze and record the hardware population between captures; a physical change invalidates persistence comparison rather than proving drift.
Do not equate missing OS enumeration with Available without considering disabled, hidden, failed or firmware-owned devices.
Bind usage to full slot identity; duplicate or generic designations alone are insufficient.
Stop on unexpected population change, unsupported enum, identity mismatch or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw/decoded Type 9 usage with stable identity, optionally correlate read-only PCI inventory under the approved policy and compare before/after reboot.
Do not manipulate hardware or device bindings and do not issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve and freeze the population/usage baseline and exception policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, resolve any firmware-versus-OS population ambiguity and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field selector is relevant, but grep loses the owning slot and cannot establish whether the hardware population was unchanged or whether a device should enumerate in the OS.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete Type 9 records and a timestamped population inventory; compare raw Current Usage enum per stable slot identity and keep optional PCI correlation explicitly policy-driven.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The System Current Usage scope, Type 9 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate raw usage enum per exact slot against a frozen, approved population state and explicit firmware-to-PCI correlation rules; repeat after reboot without modifying hardware.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board/riser, parser and optional PCI-tool versions plus a population timestamp/hash.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 9 Current Usage enumeration, approved project population/topology record and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds population provenance, exact slot attribution and exception handling instead of treating the decoded usage word as self-validating.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; distinguishes firmware metadata errors from intentional disabled/hidden/non-enumerating configurations.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Frozen population baseline and firmware-to-OS usage interpretation policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS PCI enumeration may not expose every physically installed or firmware-owned device and cannot independently prove occupancy.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve Unknown or a non-enumerating In Use slot for documented firmware-owned/disabled configurations, but must record the exact slot and population state; a later card change requires a new plan.
expected_evidence: Approved topology, frozen hardware population, per-slot usage expectation and exception policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 9 records with handle, designation, slot ID, raw/decoded usage and supported bus address
Timestamped optional PCI inventory with explicit correlation result
Approved reboot/health evidence, confirmation of unchanged population and equivalent post-reboot comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets Type 9 Current Usage correctness and persistence; hardware manipulation is neither stated nor required.

blocked_analysis.analysis: With a frozen approved population, usage collection and comparison are automatable; absent population inputs are readiness requirements.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds population provenance, exact slot identity and OS-enumeration caveats.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves its no-manipulation and correlation safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates the owner-supplied population baseline and formal verdict from automation capability.

review_improvement: Prevents false Available/In Use conclusions caused by hidden or firmware-owned devices and prevents reboot persistence claims across an unrecorded population change.
independent_technical_reasoning: Current Usage is a structured Type 9 enum; against a fixed approved population and mapping policy, software collection and comparison are deterministic and require no physical operation.
